conclusion: For the 1178-layer test.3mf workload, the evaluated structural filter changed support geometry. RoadAnalysis, cross-tree indexing, a 64 MiB candidate cache, and grounded-root early exit preserved all 351973 support paths but showed no robust slicing-time benefit over a current-host clean-source baseline of 607.785 seconds; the source was therefore restored to the clean commit rather than retaining unproductive complexity.

verification.method: Incremental Release builds, real CLI slices of the original 3MF, full support-stream comparisons at 0.01 mm, and repeated wall-clock measurements
verification.summary: Clean source: 607.785 seconds. RoadAnalysis: 611.160; cross-tree: 612.581 and 630.050; candidate cache: 721.779; grounded-root early exit: 697.751 seconds. All these variants matched 1178 layers and 351973 support paths with zero geometry differences. Structural-only, structural-copy, and structural-empty variants had 21153 different support segments and were rejected.
